nextGame.note: Friday night road game at Charlotte. Six o'clock our time. Charlotte has won one game and lost six.

news.headline: Tulane's freshman quarterback makes his first road start
news.summary: Trace Johnson has started two games for Tulane, both at home. Friday night at Charlotte will be his first start on the road.

news.headline: Two Tulane running backs are banged up
news.summary: Jamauri McClure hurt his foot again on his first carry against UTSA and ran the ball only four times. Maurice Turner did not play in that game at all.

news.headline: Tulane will start its fifth different offensive line
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said the Green Wave will put out their fifth different starting offensive line of the season on Friday night at Charlotte. He said the group is really banged up, and young players who have not played much will have to fill in.

nextGame.note: Florida plays Georgia in Atlanta on Halloween afternoon. Half past two our time. Georgia is ranked third in the country and has won six games and lost one.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: Florida will start Aaron Philo against Georgia on Saturday. He hurt his shoulder against South Carolina on October 10 and missed the Texas game, and Tramell Jones started that one instead.

news.headline: Florida's leading receiver is likely to play at Georgia
news.summary: Florida says Vernell Brown III will probably play Saturday against Georgia. He leads the team in catches and has been on the hurt list for four weeks with a knee injury.

news.headline: Both Florida quarterbacks are banged up for Georgia
news.summary: Florida listed Aaron Philo and Tramell Jones as questionable for Saturday's game at Georgia, which means neither one is certain to play. Coach Jon Sumrall said both are available and that he will pick the starter based on who is healthy.

nextGame.note: Saturday night home game in Austin. Half past six our time. Mississippi State has won four games and lost three. Mississippi State will play without its starting quarterback, Kamario Taylor, who is out for the rest of the season with a foot injury.

news.headline: Colin Simmons might play Saturday for Texas
news.summary: Texas listed its best pass rusher as a maybe for Saturday night against Mississippi State. He hurt his ankle in the Florida game, and receiver Cam Coleman, who hurt a shoulder against Ole Miss, is expected to play.

news.headline: Rasheem Biles is up for the Butkus Award
news.summary: The award goes to the best linebacker in college football. Biles is one of 15 players still in the running, and the list gets cut down to the finalists on November 20.

news.headline: Rasheem Biles wins an award for the Ole Miss game
news.summary: Biles intercepted a pass at the Texas 2-yard line to end an Ole Miss drive late in the first half Saturday, and he also had four tackles and knocked down two more passes. The SEC named him one of its two best defensive players of the week on Monday.

nextGame.note: Sunday home game in the Superdome against Cleveland. Noon our time. The Saints are off this Sunday, so this game is two Sundays away. Cleveland has won five games and lost two.

news.headline: Gayle Benson thanks the fans who went to Paris
news.summary: The Saints owner wrote an open letter to everyone who made the trip to France for Sunday's game. She said the score did not go their way, but New Orleans was represented well.

news.headline: The Saints are off this week and looking at everything
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said the bye week is for a top-to-bottom look at the team, starting with its slow starts. The Saints have been outscored 44 to 6 in the first quarter this season.

news.headline: Steelers beat the Saints 16-10 in Paris
news.summary: The Saints lost Sunday morning at Stade de France, in the first National Football League game ever played in France. They ran for only 18 yards all day, and they are now 2-5.

news.headline: IUP moves up to 27th in the country
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks climbed five spots, from 32nd to 27th, in the rankings the NCAA uses to pick teams for the national tournament. They are second in their region, behind Gannon.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon is the conference player of the week
news.summary: Concannon had 35 kills and 30 digs in IUP's two home wins last weekend, and she reached 1,000 career digs along the way. The conference named her the best player in the western half of the league on Monday.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher helps block three balls against Clarion
news.summary: Peyton played three of the four sets in Friday's win over Clarion and was in on three blocks. She had 3 kills on 14 swings with 4 errors.

news.headline: Ten Yankees become free agents
news.summary: Jazz Chisholm, Trent Grisham, Paul Goldschmidt, David Bednar and six other players filed for free agency on Thursday. Each of them is now free to sign with any team.

news.headline: Jorge Posada says he no longer feels welcome
news.summary: Posada played all 17 of his seasons for the Yankees and won five World Series with them. He said on a podcast this week that he does not feel welcome when he visits the team now, so he stays away.

news.headline: The Yankees keep their pitching coach for three more years
news.summary: Matt Blake, who coaches the Yankees' pitchers, agreed to a new three-year deal. It keeps him with the team through the 2029 season.

nextGame.note: Thursday night home game, and a district game. Seven o'clock kickoff. This game decides the district. Bonnabel has won five games and lost three and leads the district at 4-0. Warren Easton is 4-1 in the district after Thursday's loss.

news.headline: John Ehret beats Warren Easton 35-18
news.summary: Warren Easton lost Thursday night in Marrero. It was the Eagles' first district loss and it ended a four-game winning streak, and it drops them from first place in the district to third.

news.headline: Warren Easton shuts out West Jefferson 44-0
news.summary: The Eagles won at home Saturday afternoon for their fourth win in a row. Warren Easton is 4-4 and has won all four of its district games.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins a third district game, 22-6
news.summary: The Eagles beat East Jefferson 22-6 on Thursday night in Metairie for their third win in a row. Warren Easton is 3-4 for the year and has won all three of its district games.
